# The Knotbriar

*A vast, deeply touched bramble has knotted itself round the forest's oldest root where it rises through the Hidden Spring, and it is slowly tightening. Its thorn whips strike where the red marks show; when the coils tighten, the whole floor is in reach. Potions work at the Hidden Spring; scrolls do not.*
